note: PER-REPOSITORY CONTRACT — this is the example shipped with the public tree, copied to configs/repo_profiles.json by scripts/export_public.py. Replace it with your own repository: the evidence bundle is the machine-readable form of the rule that a worker must prove EVERY gate its repository requires, not a subset. Add a profile before queueing issues for a new repository; the bridge refuses to mint a brief for an unknown profile (fail-closed). local_path may stay null: pass --repo-path, or set the environment variable named in local_path_env.

evidence_bundle.source: Makefile target 'build': a change is not accepted uncompiled
AGENTS.md -> code quality rules, item 1 (mandatory before any commit, 0 issues)
AGENTS.md -> code quality rules, item 4 (all tests pass before creating a commit)

sample-service.bundle_source: AGENTS.md -> 'code quality rules (mandatory before any commit)' plus the Makefile build target
pr_rules: one task = one PR: exactly one issue, one branch, one pull request
PR body embeds the evidence bundle verbatim (command, output, exit code)
branch <role>/issue-<n> off main; never commit or push to main
changes stay inside this repository; no infra/GitOps repos
the reviewer re-runs the bundle in a separate worktree of the PR head commit: an unproven command is a REJECT regardless of the code

kanban.note: project=<slug> anchors the task in an isolated git worktree of the target clone with a deterministic branch; the worker commits and pushes that branch and opens the PR itself when `gh auth status` succeeds. Without an execution backend use --target backlog.
